huber_deriv_clamp:
theorem huber_deriv_clamp (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) :
    deriv (huber delta) r = max (-delta) (min r delta)
huber_convex:
theorem huber_convex (delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (huber delta)
huber_deriv_bound:
theorem huber_deriv_bound (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) :
    |deriv (huber delta) r| ≤ delta
huber_deriv_source:
theorem huber_deriv_source (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) :
    deriv (huber delta) r = if |r| ≤ delta then r else delta * Real.sign r
